services.meta.title: Robotics services: assessment, deployment | Professional Robotics
services.meta.description: Full cycle: site assessment, ROI, pilot, design, integration, training and SLA-backed service. From the first meeting to day-to-day operation.
services.hero.title: Full cycle: from site assessment to SLA-backed service.
services.hero.lead: We don’t sell a box. We are responsible for making the solution work on your site and keep working.
services.hero.text: So our service covers the whole path: work out the economics, prove it in a pilot, deploy, train your people and maintain the fleet.
services.route.label: Project route: three stages, twelve services
services.route.title: Project route
services.before.title: Numbers and a test first, purchase second.
services.before.lead: Before you invest, you see where money is lost, which equipment fits and how soon it pays back. A pilot confirms the numbers on your site.
services.before.audit.text: A site visit, a review of your processes and a calculation of where money is lost.
services.before.selection.text: Equipment and scenarios for the task, not tied to one vendor: we compare 2–5 manufacturers.
services.before.roi.text: A transparent payback model before you invest.
services.before.pilot.text: A test on a real area that confirms the numbers. You decide on the purchase by the result.
services.rollout.title: We handle the whole launch: from design to a trained shift.
services.rollout.lead: One team runs the design, supply, setup and training. You don’t have to coordinate contractors with each other.
services.rollout.design.text: A robotics design for your site: zones, routes, charging points and operating scenarios.
services.rollout.supply.text: Import, logistics, customs, commissioning. We handle the deal from the contract to delivery on site and help with installments and leasing.
services.rollout.integration.text: Scenario setup and connection to your infrastructure: elevators, doors, your business systems and the Professional Robotics Platform. If the vendor’s software lacks a feature, we build it.
services.rollout.training.text: So that people on site work with the system confidently: start-up, giving the robot tasks, simple faults.
services.operation.title: A robot without service stops. We make sure it keeps working.
services.operation.lead: The project doesn’t end at launch. Our own service network across Russia and a platform that spots a fault before it turns into downtime.
services.operation.chain.label: Diagram: the platform spots a deviation, an AI agent predicts the failure, an engineer arrives before downtime
services.operation.chain.signalNote: The state of each robot in the fleet
services.operation.chain.forecast: An AI agent predicts the failure
services.operation.chain.forecastNote: Our own code, not vendor software
services.operation.chain.visitNote: Response time is fixed in the SLA
services.operation.maintenance.text: Preventive maintenance, diagnostics, repair. Our own network across Russia.
services.operation.sla.text: Guaranteed response and recovery times, fixed in the contract.
services.operation.monitoring.text: Fleet condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.
services.operation.consulting.text: A robotics strategy for companies with several sites.
